"""Gate 21 diagnostic (not a product test): why the fp16 Triton GGUF dequant is not bitwise the reference on
gfx1151, and how close the fused GEMV is to the fp64 bound. Prints JSON (DIAG ...) and fails on purpose so the
captured output lands in the pytest log; the verdict reads the printed numbers, not pass / fail."""

import json

import pytest
import torch

from unsloth_zoo.gguf_kernels import GGML_BLOCK, GGMLType as T, dequantize_gguf, dequantize_reference, gguf_linear
from unsloth_zoo.gguf_kernels.testing import random_packed

cuda = pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason = "needs a GPU")
TYPES = [T.Q4_0, T.Q5_0, T.Q8_0, T.Q6_K, T.Q3_K, T.IQ4_XS, T.IQ4_NL, T.Q4_K, T.Q4_1]


def _row_length(t, blocks = 3):
    return GGML_BLOCK[t][0] * blocks if GGML_BLOCK[t][0] > 1 else 96


def _bits(a):
    return a.float().cpu().view(torch.int32)


def _diff(a, b):
    a32, b32 = a.float().cpu(), b.float().cpu()
    bad = (_bits(a) != _bits(b)) & ~(torch.isnan(a32) & torch.isnan(b32))
    n = int(bad.sum())
    out = {"n": n}
    if n:
        av, bv = a32[bad], b32[bad]
        tiny = torch.finfo(torch.float16).tiny
        out["signed_zero"] = int(((av == 0) & (bv == 0)).sum())
        out["b_subnormal"] = int(((bv != 0) & (bv.abs() < tiny)).sum())
        out["a_zero_b_nonzero"] = int(((av == 0) & (bv != 0)).sum())
        nz = (av != 0) & (bv != 0)
        out["both_nonzero"] = int(nz.sum())
        if nz.any():
            ulp = (_bits(av[nz].half()).to(torch.int64) - _bits(bv[nz].half()).to(torch.int64))
            out["ulp_hist"] = {str(int(k)): int(v) for k, v in zip(*torch.unique(ulp, return_counts = True))}
            out["toward_zero"] = int((av[nz].abs() < bv[nz].abs()).sum())
        out["examples"] = [[float(x), float(y)] for x, y in zip(av[:6].tolist(), bv[:6].tolist())]
    return out


@cuda
def test_fp16_dequant_diag():
    rep = {"device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "hip": torch.version.hip}
    for t in TYPES:
        r = {}
        for rows, blocks, seed in ((1, 1, 3), (7, 3, 4), (65, 8, 5)):
            K = _row_length(t, blocks)
            packed = random_packed(t, rows, K, seed = seed)
            want16 = dequantize_reference(packed, t, (rows, K), torch.float16)
            want32 = dequantize_reference(packed, t, (rows, K), torch.float32)
            k16 = dequantize_gguf(packed.cuda(), t, (rows, K), torch.float16)
            k32 = dequantize_gguf(packed.cuda(), t, (rows, K), torch.float32)
            r[f"{rows}x{K}"] = {
                "kernel16_vs_ref16": _diff(k16, want16),
                "kernel32_vs_ref32": _diff(k32, want32)["n"],
                "torchgpucast_vs_ref16": _diff(k32.to(torch.float16), want16),
                "ref32_cpucast_vs_ref16": _diff(want32.to(torch.float16), want16)["n"],
                "kernel16_vs_torchgpucast": _diff(k16, k32.to(torch.float16))["n"],
            }
        rep[str(t.name if hasattr(t, "name") else t)] = r
    print("DIAG_DEQ " + json.dumps(rep))
    pytest.fail("diagnostic only: " + json.dumps({k: {kk: vv["kernel16_vs_ref16"]["n"] for kk, vv in v.items()} if isinstance(v, dict) and k not in ("device", "hip") else v for k, v in rep.items()})[:1400])


@cuda
def test_fused_linear_bound_diag():
    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 8 else torch.float16
    rep = {"dtype": str(dtype)}
    for t in (T.Q4_1, T.Q4_0, T.Q8_0, T.Q4_K, T.Q6_K):
        for M in (1, 5, 16, 40):
            N, K = 72, _row_length(t, 4 if GGML_BLOCK[t][0] < 256 else 2)
            packed = random_packed(t, N, K, seed = M, special = False).cuda()
            w32 = dequantize_reference(packed, t, (N, K))
            g = torch.Generator(device = "cuda").manual_seed(M)
            x = torch.randn(M, K, device = "cuda", dtype = dtype, generator = g)
            got = gguf_linear(x, packed, t, (N, K))
            stock = torch.nn.functional.linear(x, w32.to(dtype))
            via32 = (x.float() @ w32.cuda().float().t()).to(dtype)
            ref = x.double() @ w32.double().t()
            e = lambda y: (y.double() - ref).abs()  # noqa: E731
            ulp = torch.finfo(dtype).eps * ref.abs().max().item()
            rep[f"{t.name if hasattr(t, 'name') else t}_M{M}"] = {
                "got_mean": e(got).mean().item(), "stock_mean": e(stock).mean().item(), "fp32_mean": e(via32).mean().item(),
                "got_max": e(got).max().item(), "stock_max": e(stock).max().item(), "fp32_max": e(via32).max().item(), "ulp": ulp,
                "ok_mean": bool(e(got).mean() <= 1.5 * e(stock).mean() + 1e-12), "ok_max": bool(e(got).max() <= e(stock).max() + ulp)}
    print("DIAG_LIN " + json.dumps(rep))
    pytest.fail("diagnostic only: " + json.dumps({k: [v["ok_mean"], v["ok_max"]] for k, v in rep.items() if isinstance(v, dict)})[:1400])


@cuda
def test_gemv_split_flat_diag(monkeypatch):
    from unsloth_zoo.gguf_kernels import ops as O
    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] >= 8 else torch.float16
    rep = {}
    for t in (T.Q4_0, T.Q4_1, T.Q5_0, T.Q5_1, T.Q8_0, T.Q4_K, T.Q6_K, T.IQ4_NL):
        N, K = 72, _row_length(t, 4 if GGML_BLOCK[t][0] < 256 else 2)
        packed = random_packed(t, N, K, seed = 1, special = False).cuda()
        w32 = dequantize_reference(packed, t, (N, K))
        x = torch.randn(1, K, device = "cuda", dtype = dtype, generator = torch.Generator(device = "cuda").manual_seed(1))
        ref = x.double() @ w32.double().t()
        r = {}
        for name, nosplit in (("split", frozenset()), ("flat", frozenset((t,)))):
            monkeypatch.setattr(O, "_NO_SPLIT_GEMV", nosplit)
            got = gguf_linear(x, packed, t, (N, K))
            r[name] = float((got.double() - ref).norm() / ref.norm())
        r["split_used"] = bool(O._gemv_split(t)) if hasattr(O, "_gemv_split") else "n/a"
        rep[str(t.name if hasattr(t, "name") else t)] = r
    print("DIAG_GEMV " + json.dumps(rep))
    pytest.fail("diagnostic only: " + json.dumps(rep)[:1400])
